basis.selection_reason: 011 执行与比较成功，使用该表已验证日期；优先 010 同题候选 / 共同兼容日，再按日期升序
basis.value_representation: Unmodified DuckDB CAST AS VARCHAR; SQL NULL is JSON null. Keys use the unchanged historical L0 normalization.

edits.old: SELECT po.organization_id,pr.job_profile_id,count(DISTINCT b.position_id) similar_positions_in_department FROM base b LEFT JOIN po ON b.position_id=po.position_id AND b.source_relation=po.source_relation AND po.rn=1 LEFT JOIN profiles pr ON b.position_id=pr.position_id AND b.source_relation=pr.source_relation GROUP BY po.organization_id,pr.job_profile_id
edits.new: SELECT o.organization_id,pr.job_profile_id,count(*) similar_positions_in_department FROM base b LEFT JOIN po ON b.position_id=po.position_id AND b.source_relation=po.source_relation AND po.rn=1 LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__organization o ON po.organization_id=o.organization_id AND po.source_relation=o.source_relation LEFT JOIN profiles pr ON b.position_id=pr.position_id AND b.source_relation=pr.source_relation GROUP BY o.organization_id,pr.job_profile_id
